description: Header file defining functions and data structures for managing RTBus context operations, including initialization, path conversion, context retrieval and setting, and synchronization control within a C project.

methods.name: Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes the context helper API, managing internal reference counts for safe repeated calls.

methods.name: Context_Release
methods.description: Releases resources held by the context helper API, should be called once for each Context_Init call.

methods.name: ConvertPath
methods.description: Converts a path with row aliases to one with only instance numbers, with a static buffer internally used.

methods.name: GetParentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the context associated with a parameter inside a row.

methods.name: GetRowContext
methods.description: Gets the context of a specified row.

methods.name: SetRowContext
methods.description: Sets the context for a new row, given table name, instance number, optional alias, and context data.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByInstNum
methods.description: Removes the context associated with a row identified by its instance number.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByName
methods.description: Removes the context for a row specified by its full name including alias.

methods.name: IsTimeToSyncDynamicTable
methods.description: Determines if it is appropriate to synchronize dynamic tables at the current time for a given path.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Extracts the leaf parameter name from a full path.

methods.name: GetHandlerContext
methods.description: Retrieves a handler context object for a specific element name.

ctags.pattern: /^    char const* fullName;   \/*full name of element with any table alias converted to instance n/

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^    char const* name;       \/*leaf name of element*\/$/
